claims.text: Hamza Dahdouh and Mustafa Thuraya killed 7 Jan 2024 near Khan Younis with their driver; two freelancers wounded; WaPo: Thuraya's drone footage shows no soldiers, aircraft or military equipment; 14 witnesses: 'no indications' of anything but journalism; IDF said first a 'terrorist who operated an aircraft', then that both belonged to PIJ/Hamas; 'nothing further to add'; Khan: 'It's not enough to say that we suspected them so we killed them.'

Ismail al-Ghoul and Rami al-Rifi killed 31 Jul 2024 at al-Shati; IDF called al-Ghoul a 'Nukhba terrorist', citing a document saying he got the rank in 2007, when (born 1997) he was about 10; Al Jazeera noted his arrest and release by Israel in March 2024; RSF filed ICC complaints.

Anas al-Sharif killed 10 Aug 2025 with colleagues Mohammed Qreiqeh, Ibrahim Zaher, Mohammed Noufal and Moamen Aliwa in a tent near al-Shifa; IDF said he led a Hamas rocket cell, citing documents released Oct 2024; Guardian: 'unconvincing dossier'; CPJ: no 'credible evidence'; CPJ and UN rapporteur warned in July 2025 for his safety; Guterres called for independent investigation; last message: 'If these words reach you, know that Israel has succeeded in killing me and silencing my voice.'

Nasser hospital 25 Aug 2025: first strike killed Reuters cameraman Hussam al-Masri; a second strike on the staircase killed 20 more incl. AP visual journalist Mariam Dagga; 22 killed; target reportedly a suspected Hamas camera; army said six killed were linked to Hamas without evidence; a year later no findings released; anonymous soldier: no evidence linking camera to Hamas.
